title: The lookup, MCP, ingest and decision tests are the lookup eval, one test per server tool and the untrusted-code guards
goal: The 14 test files of the lookup and its servers, ingest, decisions, logs and roots (test_kb_lookup.py, test_route.py, test_kb_ask_route.py, test_kb_mcp.py, test_kb_http.py, test_kbingest.py, test_kbingest_windows.py, test_kbdecide.py, test_kblog.py, test_kb_root.py, test_kbroot.py, test_provider.py, test_benchmarks.py, test_agent_bench.py) hold only the 36 tests the notes' KEEP list names (665 ids on 2026-10-05), LIVE_DATA_TESTS names only tests that exist, every removed id is in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt under a reason line naming the operator's direction of 2026-10-05 and the kept test of its file that still reaches the module, and every tool module is still reached by a test; a full tests.py spends about 260 worker-seconds less (about 0.6 min of wall on macOS, about 2.8 min on the Windows host). It no longer catches: the pack's tag grammar, code pointers, routes and check lines case by case (the lookup eval's real questions still run); the kb_ask routing plans; each MCP tool's options, the plugin manifest's worker and dispatch pins, status and the live-docs cache; the HTTP transport's status codes and chunking; the ingest toolchain mappers (go, cargo, dotnet, node, typescript) and pin readers; each kbdecide and kblog refusal, sweep and relink; the retired autopilot ratify and rot-metric tests. They show as a wrong pack in the query log's findings and a failed lookup eval.
notes: KEEP, test_ names without the prefix, [1] the first case (all else in these files goes): kb_lookup: lookup_eval_passes, e2e_fixture_questions_keep_their_pack, persisted_index_gives_identical_packs, kb_hook, live_data_size_independent_list, log_tag_refused_in_public_root; route: clean_good_packs_keep_their_text_and_flagged_ones_route_split; kb_ask_route: the_real_pack_of_a_covered_question_plans_good; kb_mcp: exits_on_eof_and_stdout_is_only_jsonrpc, tools_list, kb_pack_audit_facts_cited, only_read_only_skills, submit_feedback_blocked_on_every_docs_server, claude_plugin_validate; kb_http: kb_http_transport_binds_loopback, kb_http_transport_tools_list_and_call, kb_http_guard_bad_origin_is_403[1], kb_http_guard_public_bind_refused[1]; kbingest: survey_leaves_out_and_keeps, kbingest_map_planted_ast_shadow_is_not_run, kbingest_map_symlink_is_not_followed, kbingest_map_scrub_env, kbingest_map_a_program_inside_the_worktree_is_never_run, kbingest_map_redact_leaks_keeps_the_rest; kbdecide: kbdecide_propose_adds_a_proposed_row_that_passes_check, kbdecide_confirm_needs_by_operator, kbdecide_withdraw_supersede_and_restore_refuse_without_by_operator; kblog: kblog_record_confirm_adds_a_proposed_row_that_the_operator_makes_active, kblog_record_confirm_refuses_raw_event_text[1]; kb_root: second_root_is_packed_filtered_and_shown, decisions_store_plants_one_failure_per_decision_rule; kbroot: new_root_passes_the_checks; kbingest_windows, provider, benchmarks, agent_bench: the first collected test of each. Premise: pytest --collect-only -q over the 14 files collects 665 (7fbf1f2d5). Seconds from the last full run (test_kb_lookup.py 84 s, test_kb_mcp.py 46, test_kbingest.py 45, test_kbdecide.py 38, test_kb_root.py 24), pro rata. The checks pass before the work. No gate: test files and reasons only, under the operator's settled direction.
